definition: A commitment to develop or deploy digital applications or services that help users adapt to climate risks: climate advisory services for farmers, climate-smart agriculture tools delivered digitally, drought management applications, adaptation-focused decision tools, digital resilience services. Counts when the digital tool is financed or deployed by the project. Does not count: climate-smart practices or investments with no digital component, or generic digital services with no adaptation function.
note: First cut from Dev's measure template, 2026-10-20; patterns anchored to a climate or energy word where the bare word would match thousands of sentences.
